final:
next_rand(state: int) -> int =
  pre state >= 0
  pre state < 2147483647
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483647
  ex next_rand(1) == 48271
  (state * 48271) % 2147483647

shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 1) == [5]
  ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 42) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 42)
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  let n = xs.len()
  var state = seed % 2147483646 + 1
  for k in range(1, n)
    let i = n - k
    state = next_rand(state)
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let a = ys[i]
    let b = ys[j]
    ys[i] = b
    ys[j] = a
  ys
